mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE comments SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id as postId, c.user_id as userId, c.parent_comment_id as parentCommentId, c.content, u.name as userName, u.nickname as userNickname, u.profile_image as userProfileImage, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as isDeleted FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.post_id as postId, c.user_id as userId, c.parent_comment_id as parentCommentId, c.content, u.name as userName, u.profile_image as userProfileImage, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, FALSE as isDeleted FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id as postId, c.user_id as userId, c.parent_comment_id as parentCommentId, c.content, u.name as userName, u.profile_image as userProfileImage, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, FALSE as isDeleted FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_comment_id = #{parentCommentId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id as postId, c.user_id as userId, c.parent_comment_id as parentCommentId, c.content, u.name as userName, u.nickname as userNickname, u.profile_image as userProfileImage, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as isDeleted, cp.title as postTitle FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN community_posts cp ON c.post_id = cp.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
